ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: DS Bot uses the camera to scan the pairing code that your computer shows.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: DS Bot asks for Face ID before it hands out a secret, connects a connector or changes what a Bot may do.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DS Bot opens a photo you pick so you can send it in a chat.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: DS Bot reaches the Relay Server on your own computer over the local network.
